title: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023
description: With GTA 6 officially releasing next month, take a look at how protagonists Jason and Lucia have evolved visually since their 2023 reveal.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Tracing the Visual Evolution of Jason and Lucia in GTA 6

As Grand Theft Auto VI officially prepares to release next month, anticipation within the gaming community has reached an all-time high. IGN recently shared a retrospective look at how the game's two central protagonists, Jason and Lucia, have evolved since they were first revealed to the public back in 2023.

### From the 2023 Reveal to the Brink of Launch

When Rockstar Games first introduced Jason and Lucia in their initial 2023 trailer, the duo immediately captured the imagination of fans worldwide with their Bonnie and Clyde-style dynamic set against the backdrop of Leonida. Over the subsequent months and through subsequent promotional materials, observant fans and media outlets have noted various visual refinements made to both characters.

According to IGN's comparison, the transition from their initial 2023 appearance to the models seen closer to the game's launch showcases enhanced textures, more detailed facial animations, and improved lighting interactions. These subtle adjustments highlight Rockstar's dedication to pushing technical boundaries, ensuring that Jason and Lucia look and feel as grounded and expressive as possible in the expansive open world.

### The Final Countdown to Release

With only a month left until GTA 6 hits shelves, the journey of Jason and Lucia from their initial announcement to their final in-game forms is nearly complete. Their evolution reflects the continuous polish applied during the final stages of development, raising excitement even higher for what promises to be a landmark release in gaming history.

## Editor's Take

Seeing how Jason and Lucia have evolved visually since 2023 underscores Rockstar Games' relentless pursuit of perfection. As we count down the final month before GTA 6 officially launches, these subtle character refinements only amplify our excitement to dive into the criminal underworld of Leonida and experience their story firsthand.
